airSquat.description: Un movimiento fundamental de peso corporal que mejora la fuerza y movilidad del tren inferior.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to sit back into your hips.
Lower your body until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your weight on your heels, not your toes.
Ensure your knees stay in line with your toes and don't cave inward.
Maintain a neutral spine throughout the entire movement.

gobletSquat.description: Sostener un peso a la altura del pecho mientras se hace la sentadilla ayuda a mejorar la técnica y la estabilidad del core.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your hips back and down, keeping your chest up and the weight close to your body.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed down and inside your knees at the bottom of the squat.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you push back up.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back.

barbellBackSquat.description: El estándar de oro para desarrollar la fuerza total del cuerpo y la masa de las piernas con barra.
instructions: Position the barbell across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out.
Brace your core and lower your hips until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to an upright position.
tips: Keep your chest up and look slightly forward throughout the lift.
Avoid letting your knees cave inward.
Use a squat rack and a spotter for safety when lifting heavy.

walkingLunge.description: Un movimiento funcional que desarrolla la fuerza unilateral, el equilibrio y la coordinación.
instructions: Step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Ensure your front knee is directly above your ankle.
Drive through the front heel to stand up and step forward with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs as you walk forward.
tips: Keep your torso upright and your core engaged.
Don't let your back knee touch the floor with impact.
Maintain your balance by focusing on a spot in front of you.

legPress.description: Una prensa en máquina que permite cargar el tren inferior con un peso elevado y una tensión mínima en la espalda.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back and head flat against the padded support.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety bars and lower the platform toward your chest by bending your knees.
Push the platform back to the starting position without locking your knees at the top.
tips: Avoid lifting your lower back off the seat.
Keep your feet flat on the platform at all times.
Control the weight during both the lowering and pushing phases.

deadlift.description: Un levantamiento fundamental para la fuerza total del cuerpo, dirigido a toda la cadena posterior.
instructions: Stand with your mid-foot under the barbell.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Keep your back flat and chest up as you drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout the movement and stand fully upright.
tips: Don't round your back; maintain a neutral spine.
Inhale and brace your core before you pull the weight.
Lower the bar by hinging at the hips first, then bending your knees once the bar clears them.

romanianDeadlift.description: Una variante de peso muerto que enfatiza el estiramiento y la contracción de los isquiotibiales.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar toward the floor while keeping your legs mostly straight (slight bend in knees).
Lower the bar until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.
tips: Keep the bar very close to your legs at all times.
Focus on pushing your hips back as far as possible.
Avoid rounding your shoulders or lower back.

pushUp.description: Un ejercicio clásico de peso corporal que desarrolla la fuerza del pecho, los hombros y los tríceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Push through your palms to return to the starting position.
tips: Don't let your lower back sag; keep your core tight.
Focus on a full range of motion for better muscle engagement.
Breathe in as you lower and out as you push back up.

benchPress.description: El levantamiento fundamental de tren superior para desarrollar la máxima potencia de pecho y brazos.
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the floor.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest in a controlled manner.
Drive the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades retracted (squeezed together) throughout the lift.
Maintain a slight arch in your lower back, but keep your glutes on the bench.
Use a spotter, especially when lifting heavy weights.

inclineBenchPress.description: Un press inclinado que se dirige a la parte superior del pecho y a los hombros.
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit with your back against the bench and feet flat on the floor.
Press the dumbbells upward from shoulder height until your arms are extended over your chest.
Lower the weights back to shoulder level with control.
tips: Don't let the dumbbells drift too far forward or backward.
Focus on squeezing your upper chest at the top of the movement.
Maintain a stable core to avoid excessive arching.

overheadPress.description: Un press vertical potente que desarrolla hombros anchos y estabilidad en el tren superior.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and press the bar directly overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lock out your elbows at the top and push your head slightly forward.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders with control.
tips: Don't use your legs to help lift the weight (that's a push press).
Keep your core and glutes tight to stabilize your torso.
Focus on a vertical bar path.

lateralRaise.description: El ejercicio de aislamiento clave para desarrollar la anchura de los hombros.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides with a slight bend in your elbows until they are level with your shoulders.
Pause for a second at the top, then slowly lower the weights back to your sides.
tips: Don't swing the weights or use momentum.
Lead with your elbows, not your wrists.
Imagine you are pouring water out of a pitcher at the top of the movement.

chestDip.description: A dip variation where you lean your torso forward to shift the focus from the triceps to the chest muscles.
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and push yourself up to the starting position.
Lean your torso forward at about a 45-degree angle as you lower your body.
Allow your elbows to flare out slightly as you descend.
Push back up to the starting position while maintaining the forward lean.
tips: Squeeze your chest at the top of the movement.
Lower yourself until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows.
Control the descent to avoid shoulder strain.

tricepsPushdown.description: Un ejercicio popular en polea para aislar y desarrollar la parte posterior de los brazos.
instructions: Attach a bar or rope to a high pulley on a cable machine.
Grip the attachment and pull it down until your elbows are at a 90-degree angle.
Push the attachment down until your arms are fully extended, squeezing your triceps at the bottom.
Slowly return to the 90-degree starting position.
tips: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides throughout the set.
Avoid using your body weight to push the cable down.
Maintain a slight forward lean and engaged core.

pullUp.description: Un movimiento de peso corporal de élite para desarrollar una espalda ancha y potente y brazos fuertes.
instructions: Grip the bar with your palms facing away from you, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your core engaged.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down toward your hips.
Lower yourself back to the starting position with control.
tips: Focus on pulling with your back muscles rather than just your arms.
Avoid swinging your legs or using momentum (kipping).
If you can't perform a full pull-up, start with assisted variations or negatives.

latPulldown.description: Un ejercicio en máquina que permite desarrollar la fuerza de tracción vertical de forma controlada.
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the knee pads so you are securely held in place.
Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width and lean back slightly.
Pull the bar down toward your upper chest, focusing on squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.
tips: Don't pull the bar behind your neck; pull it to your upper chest.
Focus on leading with your elbows.
Control the weight on the way up to maintain tension in your lats.

seatedCableRow.description: Se dirige al grosor de la espalda tirando de las poleas hacia el torso en posición sentada.
instructions: Sit with your feet on the platforms and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the handle and sit up straight with your arms extended.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly return to the starting position without letting the weight stack slam.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid rocking your torso back and forth.
Focus on pulling with your elbows rather than your hands.
Maintain a stable core throughout the movement.

bentOverRow.description: Un movimiento compuesto potente que desarrolla el grosor de la espalda y la fuerza general del tren superior.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees slightly, keeping your back flat.
Pull the barbell toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower the bar back to the starting position with control.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine and avoid rounding your back.
Keep your core engaged to support your lower back.
Don't use momentum to 'cheat' the weight up.

facePull.description: Esencial para la salud del hombro, dirigido a los deltoides posteriores y los músculos de la parte superior de la espalda.
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable pulley at upper-chest or eye level.
Grip the ends of the rope with your thumbs pointing back.
Pull the rope toward your forehead, pulling the ends apart as you get closer to your face.
Focus on squeezing your rear delts and mid-back at the end of the movement.
tips: Keep your elbows high and out to the sides.
Avoid using your lower back to pull; stay upright and stable.
Use lighter weights and focus on the quality of the contraction.

bicepsCurl.description: El ejercicio de aislamiento clásico para desarrollar y definir los bíceps.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top, then slowly lower the weights back down.
Keep your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
tips: Avoid swinging your body or using momentum to lift the weights.
Keep your elbows tucked in close to your torso.
Full range of motion: extend your arms fully at the bottom.

hammerCurl.description: Un curl con agarre neutro que trabaja el bíceps y el braquial para conseguir unos brazos más gruesos.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your torso (neutral grip).
Curl the weights up while maintaining the neutral grip.
Squeeze at the top and lower back down with control.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
tips: Focus on the contraction in your biceps and forearms.
Maintain an upright posture and avoid swaying.
Can be performed alternating arms or both together.

plank.description: Un ejercicio de core fundamental que desarrolla fuerza isométrica y estabilidad en toda la sección media.
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor, elbows aligned under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you and balance on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and hold the position.
tips: Avoid letting your hips sag or hike up too high.
Maintain a neutral neck position; look down at the floor.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

sidePlank.description: Se centra en los oblicuos y en la estabilidad lateral del core para mejorar el equilibrio y prevenir el dolor de espalda.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stack your feet.
Prop your upper body up on your forearm, with your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the position while keeping your core engaged and hips level.
tips: Don't let your hips sag toward the floor.
Keep your neck in a neutral position, looking straight ahead.
For an easier variation, perform the plank with your knees on the floor.

deadBug.description: Una forma segura y eficaz de desarrollar la estabilidad del core y la coordinación sin forzar la espalda.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees (tabletop position).
Slowly lower your right arm behind your head while simultaneously extending your left leg toward the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed firmly into the floor throughout the movement.
Return to the starting position and repeat with the opposite arm and leg.
tips: The key is to maintain a flat back; if your back arches, don't lower your leg as far.
Move slowly and with control.
Exhale as you extend your limbs.

mountainClimber.description: Un ejercicio dinámico que se dirige al core a la vez que proporciona un desafío cardiovascular importante.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then quickly switch legs, as if you are running in place in a plank position.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Maintain a consistent and rapid pace.
tips: Avoid letting your hips bounce up and down.
Focus on driving your knees straight forward.
Keep your weight centered over your hands.
